sections.shortTitle: Goods Conduct Prisoners Probational Release N -W F P Amendment Act 1996
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT V OF 1996
ACT V OF 1996
GOOD CONDUCT PRISONERS' PROBATIONAL RELEASE (NORTH-WEST FRONTIER
PROVINCE) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act further to amend the Good
Conduct Prisoners Probational Release Act, 1926
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 28th July, 1996]
No.PA/N.-W.F.P./Legis/96/12559,
dated 28-7-1996.---The Good Conduct Prisoners' Probational Release (North-West
Frontier Province) (Amendment) Bill, 1996, having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province on the 27th June, 1996 and
assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on the 15th
July, 1996, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of
North-West Frontier Province.
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the
Good Conduct Prisoners' Probational Release (North-West Frontier Province)
(Amendment) Act, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 2 Pb. Act X of 1926

ACT V OF 1996
ACT V OF 1996
GOOD CONDUCT PRISONERS' PROBATIONAL RELEASE (NORTH-WEST FRONTIER
PROVINCE) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act further to amend the Good
Conduct Prisoners Probational Release Act, 1926
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 28th July, 1996]
No.PA/N.-W.F.P./Legis/96/12559,
dated 28-7-1996.---The Good Conduct Prisoners' Probational Release (North-West
Frontier Province) (Amendment) Bill, 1996, having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province on the 27th June, 1996 and
assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on the 15th
July, 1996, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of
North-West Frontier Province.
2. Amendment of section 2 Pb. Act X of 1926.---In the Good Conduct
Prisoners Probational Release Act, 1926 (Pb. Act X of 1926), in section 2, the
full-stop appearing at the end before the 'Explanation' thereunder, shall be
replaced by a colon and the following proviso shall be inserted, namely;
Provided that a prisoner convicted
and sentenced under any of the section in Chapter XVI of the Pakistan Penal
Code (XLV of 1860) shall not be released on parole without the consent of the
victim or, as the case may be, his heirs."
